headlines.title: 반도체·원화 강세에 1인당 GNI 4만달러 눈앞 …체감소득은 '온도 차'
headlines.summary: [인천=뉴시스] 전진환 기자 = 한국은행은 반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 2분기 실질 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률(직전분기대비·잠정치)이 0.6%로 집계됐다고 8일 밝혔다. 분기 성장률은 지난해 1분기 역성장(-0.2%) 이후 2분기 0.6%, 3분기 1.4% 등으로 개선되다가 4분기 -0.1%로 다시 하락한 뒤 올해 반등했다.

headlines.title: 명목GDP 26.4% ↑… 47년만 최고
headlines.summary: 한은, 2분기 국민소득 잠정치 발표 잠정 실질GDP 0.6%…속보치와 동일 실질GNI 15.6%↑…37년6개월만 최대 한은 “올해 1인당 GNI 4만달러 시대” 반도체를 중심으로 교역 조건이 개선되면서 2분기 우리 국민의 총소득이 666조8000억원으로, 사상 최고치를 경신했다. 전년 동기 대비 증가율 또한 15.6%로 37년 6개월만에 가장 컸다.

headlines.title: ‘ 국민소득 4만불 ’ 1년 당긴 한은 ...‘반도체·환율’에 이례적 자신감...
headlines.summary: 연초 2028년 달성 전망서 시점 앞당겨 반도체 주도 총영업잉여 증가폭 최고치 환율 안정 GNI 4만달러 전망에 힘 보태 한국은행이 올해 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)가 4만달러를 넘길 것이라고 자신한 배경에는 인공지능(AI) 산업과 관련해 전 세계적으로 치솟고 있는 반도체 수요가 꼽힌다.

headlines.title: 추석 코 앞인데 … 한우 ‘ 등심 1+ ’ 1년새 34% 올라
headlines.summary: 사육·도축 동반감소에 명절수요 겹쳐 등심1+, 5분기 연속 상승 ‘고공 행진’ 美 척아이롤 21%↑…수입산도 부담 추석을 앞두고 소고기 가격이 가파른 상승세를 보이고 있다. 한우 사육 마릿수와 도축 물량이 줄어 공급이 감소한 데다 추석 성수기 수요까지 겹친 영향이다. 상대적으로 저렴한 수입 소고기 가격도 오르면서 장바구니 부담이 가중되는 모습이다.

headlines.title: 기상 여건 호조에 봄 감자 생산량 5천t 증가한 36만1천t
headlines.summary: 감자 [연합뉴스 자료사진. 재판매 및 DB 금지] (세종=연합뉴스) 김수현 기자 = 올해 기상 여건이 양호했던 영향으로 봄 감자 생산량이 늘었다. 국가데이터처가 8일 발표한 '2026년 봄 감자 생산량 조사 결과'를 보면 올해 봄 감자 생산량은 36만1천t으로, 작년보다 5천t(1.5%) 늘었다.

headlines.summary: 전세매물 94% 증가, 중소형에 수요 몰려 대단지 입주에도 전세가 5.02% 상승 59~84㎡ “없어서 못 팔아”, 대형은 부진 갈아타기 수요 지속, 입주장 효과 ‘실종’ 서울 서초구 반포동 래미안원베일리아파트.  윤승현 기자 “부동산 시장은 항상 급한 사람이 지는 법입니다.

headlines.title: 서울시 “ 계약 연장·분양전환 없다 ”… 장기전세 9300호 재공급
headlines.summary: 일부 계약연장 요구에 ‘불가’ 원칙 재확인 오세훈 “다음 무주택자 기회로 이어져야” 만기 물량은 청년·신혼부부 등에 공급 서울시가 내년 20년 만기가 도래하는 장기전세주택 310호를 시작으로 2031년까지 총 9300호를 순차적으로 반환받아 신규 입주민에게 재공급한다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트 경매 식었다는데 … 중랑·노원은 ‘ 불장 ’
headlines.summary: 8월 낙찰가율 97%로 전달보다 4%P 하락 중랑 115.2%·노원 102.8%, 중저가 후끈 전문가 “하락장땐 외곽 소형부터 조정” 경계 서울 아파트 경매 낙찰가율이 한 달 새 4%포인트 떨어지는 등 전반적으로 부진한 흐름을 보이고 있지만, 외곽지역에서는 감정가를 크게 웃도는 가격에 낙찰되는 사례가 이어지고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부 도 ‘ 영끌 ?’… 5000억 들여 수도권 주택 용지 매입
headlines.summary: ■ 공공토지 비축 매입 공모 29일부터 매각신청 접수받아 경기 광주역세권 2지구로 공개된 장지동 일대 모습. 연합뉴스 정부가 5000억 원을 들여 공공토지 매입에 나선다. 수도권 주택 수요에 대응하기 위해 도심 주택용지로 활용할 수 있는 유휴부지를 미리 마련하기 위해서다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 올해 7개월간 탈세·법규 위반 1조760억원 적발
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 탈세 1760억원…수입요건 위반 등 법규위반 9천억원 관세청, 전국 관세조사 관계관 회의 개최 이종욱 관세청장(앞줄 왼쪽에서 여섯 번째)이 7일 정부대전청사에서 열린 전국 관세조사 관계관 회의를 마친 뒤 기념 촬영하고 있다. 관세청 제공 관세청이 올해 7월까지 관세조사를 통해 탈세와 각종 수출입 법규 위반 행위 1조 760억원 상당을 적발했다.

headlines.title: 매출 4.5% 늘어도 지출 6% 증가 소상공인 이익 감소에 대출 연체↑
headlines.summary: 2Q 매출 4.53%↑ 지출 5.83%↑ 개인사업자 대출연체액 15조 돌파 이익률 하락에 두 분기째 연체액↑ 소상공인의 매출은 1년 전보다 늘었지만 지출 증가폭이 더 커 실제 이익이 줄곧 감소하고 있다는 분석이 제기됐다. 개인사업자 대출 연체액도 두 분기 연속 증가했다.

headlines.title: 명분·실리 없이 오락가락 … 금융공공기관 이전 [현장에서]
headlines.summary: ■ 현장에서 세종행이 유력해 보였던 금융위원회가 2차 행정기관 이전 대상으로 제시되지 않자 그 배경을 두고 관가가 술렁이고 있다. 이재명 대통령 지지율이 30%대에 그치자 청와대가 급히 제외한 것인데, 정책에 논리가 없다는 공직사회의 불만이 커지고 있는 것이다.

key_headlines.title: Nominal GDP Growth Reaches 47-Year High of 26.4%, Strengthening Case for October Rate Hike
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's nominal GDP surged 26.4% year-on-year in Q2 2026, the highest in 47 years, driven by semiconductor price increases, which is now weighing on the Bank of Korea's monetary policy decisions regarding a potential consecutive rate hike in October.

key_headlines.title: Korea Accelerates Achievement of 40,000 USD Per Capita GNI to This Year
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea revised its forecast, expecting Korea to surpass 40,000 USD per capita GNI this year instead of 2028, citing strong semiconductor demand driven by global AI development and currency stability.

key_headlines.title: Seoul to Recontract 9,300 Long-Term Lease Apartments Without Extension or Conversion Starting 2027
key_headlines.summary: Seoul announced plans to sequentially recover and resupply 9,300 long-term lease apartments expiring between 2027 and 2031, with units allocated to young people and newlywed couples without offering contract extensions.

key_headlines.title: Real GNI Growth of 15.6% Records 37.5-Year High as Semiconductor Trade Conditions Improve
key_headlines.summary: Korea's real GNI grew 15.6% year-on-year in Q2, the largest increase in 37 years and 6 months, with total national income reaching a record 666.8 trillion won as semiconductor exports and favorable trade conditions boosted earnings.

key_headlines.title: French AI Startup Mistral Raises 4.6 Trillion Won Led by Samsung Electronics
key_headlines.summary: Samsung Electronics led a Series D investment round for French AI startup Mistral, raising 3 billion euros (approximately 4.6 trillion won), valuing the company at over 21 billion euros in Europe's largest private technology company equity investment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing exceptional growth momentum with nominal GDP surging 26.4% year-on-year in Q2 2026, marking the highest rate in 47 years, primarily driven by elevated semiconductor export prices fueled by global AI demand. The per capita GNI is now expected to exceed 40,000 USD this year, accelerating the timeline by two years from the initial 2028 forecast. Real GNI growth reached 15.6%, the largest increase in over 37 years, reflecting improved terms of trade and strong corporate earnings that are beginning to spread to household and government sectors. However, concerns persist about consecutive rate hikes as the Bank of Korea grapples with balancing economic growth against inflation risks, with September inflation data and the potential October rate decision creating significant policy uncertainty.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea reported Q2 real GDP growth of 0.6% quarter-on-quarter, with nominal GDP expanding 26.4% year-on-year, benefiting from semiconductors and machinery exports as well as recovering private consumption. The dramatic nominal GDP growth has prompted Bank of Korea Governor to emphasize that nominal GDP should be a key monetary policy indicator, signaling potential shifts in policy frameworks. While the strong export performance and improving income metrics support optimism about Korea achieving 40,000 USD per capita GNI this year, policymakers face pressure regarding consecutive rate hikes despite the economic momentum. Comparatively, Japan's Q2 real GDP growth was revised upward to 0.4% from 0.3%, and Taiwan's economy is expected to exceed 10% growth this year, providing context for Korea's relative economic performance.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI struggled to maintain gains, failing to reclaim the 7,000 level as various headwinds including Middle East risks, elevated European government bond yields, and uncertainty around potential US Federal Reserve rate hikes weighed on sentiment. Market expectations reflect approximately 59.4% probability of a 0.25 percentage point US rate increase at the September FOMC meeting, creating volatility in Korean financial markets as investors navigate competing signals. Domestic government bond yields remain elevated in the 4% range, with the 10-year yield at 4.385% and 20-year yield at 4.567%, attracting retirement pension funds seeking higher returns amid the global bond sell-off. Global institutional investors are reportedly shifting allocations away from US Treasuries toward equities, while retail investors have suffered losses on their US bond positions despite stock market gains.
sections.Industry & Technology: Hyundai Motor is intensifying efforts to enhance battery business competitiveness to counter Chinese electric vehicle competition, leveraging safety advantages while working to improve price competitiveness through battery innovation and differentiation. AI agents are transforming semiconductor design processes, with companies like Siheights combining semiconductor design expertise with simulation technology to improve development verification and reduce time-to-market for various applications. China's abrupt halt to approvals for new Energy Storage Systems (ESS) facilities may benefit Korean battery makers, as domestic battery companies LG Energy Solution and SK On are expanding ESS production by reallocating resources from slowing electric vehicle markets. The semiconductor industry faces increased US investment pressure as trade negotiations incorporate direct investment requirements, creating challenges for companies managing their US capital allocation strategies.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul announced a plan to sequentially recover and resupply 9,300 long-term lease apartments expiring between 2027 and 2031, allocating units to young people and newlywed couples without offering contract extensions or conversion options to ownership. Strong demand for new lease apartments was evident in Daegu where buyers camped overnight for third-generation lease offerings at discounts of up to 100 million won, reflecting persistent housing demand despite macroeconomic uncertainties. The Seoul real estate market is bifurcating, with Gangnam areas experiencing price declines following tax reform measures, while some apartments like Nine One Hannam continue commanding premium prices exceeding 25.5 billion won. CR Real Estate Investment Trusts have re-emerged as a financial product, purchasing unsold apartments in provincial areas after completion and operating them as rentals before eventual sale when market conditions improve.
sections.International Economy: Canada is implementing 50% retaliatory tariffs against the United States despite repeated warnings from the Trump administration, as part of an escalating trade dispute aimed at pressuring the US back to negotiation tables and making American businesses and consumers feel the costs of the trade war. The US Federal Reserve faces mixed signals regarding rate policy, with UBS revising its forecast to expect two rate increases by year-end instead of holding steady, citing persistent inflation concerns despite employment data suggesting potential economic cooling. Middle East geopolitical tensions continue to support elevated oil prices, which in turn risk re-igniting inflation concerns and Treasury yield pressures, complicating the Fed's policy calculus while Trump administration pressure for rate cuts adds policy uncertainty. Canada's retaliatory measures include tariffs on a wide range of US goods, with the Trump administration threatening to pull aircraft purchases in response, escalating tit-for-tat trade actions.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence technology is fundamentally reshaping traditional labor market dynamics in the United States, disrupting the long-held formula that college graduation guarantees employment stability, with college-educated workers facing challenges while high school graduates experience improved job prospects. The rapid advancement of AI is forcing corporate restructuring of office work processes, reducing demand for traditional white-collar positions and altering the expected relationship between educational attainment and career outcomes. French AI startup Mistral, backed by Samsung Electronics' lead investment of 3 billion euros in Series D funding, exemplifies the accelerating AI investment landscape as companies develop sovereign AI and open-weight models allowing enterprises to maintain data control while building custom AI solutions. Global corporations including Airbus and HSBC are leveraging Mistral's technology to support their AI transformation initiatives.
sections.Others: The government confirmed that 2027 health insurance premiums will not increase, citing expanded government support of approximately 1.1 trillion won and anticipated increased insurance revenue from Korea's economic recovery driven by semiconductor export growth and improved economic conditions. Healthcare coverage will be expanded to include approximately 1.97 million individuals with conditions such as diabetes, while premium rates remain frozen and discussions on revising the premium assessment system continue. Global investment capital is increasingly flowing toward power and energy sectors driven by AI-related infrastructure demands, with Korean Export-Import Bank participating in financing for Saudi Arabia's 2GW solar projects and multiple global commercial banks showing strong interest in energy infrastructure. The Mega Special Zone Special Law introduces approximately 300 regulatory exemptions for semiconductor research and development in Honam, advanced industries in Chungcheong, and AI in Yeongnam regions, though labor provisions allow unlimited working hours for semiconductor development projects raising concerns about worker protections.
